events.content:
Done — `index.html` (~24 KB, single file, no external assets).

**The scene:** one canvas renders everything procedurally — a dark ceramic bowl on an unlit table, shoyu-miso broth, a noodle nest, and vegan toppings (seared tofu cubes, scored shiitake, bok choy, sweet corn, nori, scallion rings, sesame, chilli-crisp flecks) lit by a single warm source with a cool rim light. Vignette and film grain sit on top as CSS/canvas overlays.

**Motion:** rising steam plume driven by a Perlin-noise field (particles fade in, expand, cool from warm to neutral as they rise), shimmering oil droplets on the broth, gently swaying noodles, a slow breathing bob of the whole dish.

**Interaction:** the pointer moves the key light — bowl glaze, broth specular, noodle shading and background bloom all shift with it; the plume is physically pushed aside by the cursor; moving across the broth surface leaves expanding ripple rings. Touch drives the same path.

**Responsive:** a single design-space scale fits the bowl to any aspect (verified at 430×860, 1280×860, and 1600×600), DPR-aware up to 2×.

**Reduced motion:** `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` freezes time entirely — no particles, ripples, sway or parallax — and substitutes a soft static steam haze so the frame still reads as hot. It also responds live to the media-query change event.

excluded: large base64 and embedded image data (event retained with size marker)
